title: Dream Fragments: Freeze Immunity, Mana Scaling and Legacy Versions in 0.5
summary: Dream Fragments is a unique Sapphire Ring in Path of Exile 2 that makes you immune to Chill and Freeze, grants +(20-30)% Cold Resistance, (10-15)% increased Maximum Mana and (30-50)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate. This guide explains exactly what 'cannot be Chilled or Frozen' protects against, why it is not immunity to every Cold ailment, how the Maximum Mana roll scales a mana-stacker, whether a Divine Orb upgrades old versions, the opportunity cost versus a high-attribute Rare Ring, and how the Vaal Cultivation variant differs.
description: How Dream Fragments works in PoE2 0.5: Chill and Freeze immunity, the Cold Resistance implicit plus unique mod, 10-15% Maximum Mana scaling for mana builds, Mana Regeneration versus Maximum Mana, current vs pre-0.4 legacy, Divine Orb behaviour, Rare Ring opportunity cost, and the Vaal Cultivation version.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Path of Exile 2 Dream Fragments unique Sapphire Ring with chill and freeze immunity and maximum mana

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Dream Fragments is a unique Sapphire Ring whose 'You cannot be Chilled or Frozen' line gives you permanent immunity to the Chill and Freeze cold ailments - no flask timing, no gear juggling. On top of that it adds +(20-30)% Cold Resistance, (10-15)% increased Maximum Mana and (30-50)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate. It does NOT make you immune to every Cold ailment (Brittle, Scorch from cold, and the damage of cold hits still apply), and it is an Early Access-league luxury-priced ring, so it competes with a high-attribute Rare Ring for the slot.
calloutDetail: Chill and Freeze are removed entirely; you can still be Brittle (a cold exposure-style ailment) and you still take cold damage - the ring is ailment-status immunity, not damage immunity.
The (10-15)% Maximum Mana is the headline scaling mod for Archmage and mana-stacker builds; Mana Regeneration helps sustain, while Maximum Mana is what scales Archmage damage.
A Divine Orb re-rolls the numeric values to the current ranges; it does not add or remove modifiers, so an old 20% max-mana version becomes a 10-15% version after a Divine.

answers.label: Use it for
text: Freeze-heavy bosses and maps where being locked hurts, and mana-stacker / Archmage builds that want the Maximum Mana and the chill-free casting.

answers.label: Check first
text: Check the Maximum Mana roll (10% vs 15% matters a lot for Archmage) and whether your build actually scales with Maximum Mana before paying the trade price.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Do not assume it solves all Cold problems or that it beats a Rare Ring that gives you the attributes, life and resistances your build is missing.

sections.title: What 'You cannot be Chilled or Frozen' protects
paragraphs: Dream Fragments exists to solve one of the most punishing things in Path of Exile 2: being locked in place by Cold. Chill slows your action speed; Freeze stops you entirely. With this ring equipped, both ailment states are simply removed from you - you cannot be Chilled and you cannot be Frozen, permanently, with no flask charge or uptime window to manage. That is a huge quality-of-life and survivability win in bosses and maps where cold mechanics would otherwise pin you during a dangerous attack.

It is important to be precise about the boundary. 'Cannot be Chilled or Frozen' is ailment-status immunity, not blanket Cold immunity. You can still take Cold damage from hits and ground effects. You can still be made Brittle (the cold ailment that lowers Cold Resistance / acts like a cold Exposure). The ring does not grant ignore-Cold-damage, so cold penetration, cold exposure and Brittle still matter, and you still need Cold Resistance for the damage itself - which the ring also helps with via its +(20-30)% line.

The two scaling mods are where the ring earns a second role. (10-15)% increased Maximum Mana raises your mana pool, which is the resource that Archmage and many mana-stacker builds convert into damage or defence. (30-50)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate instead speeds the refilling of that pool. They are different stats: Maximum Mana is a pool size (what Archmage scales from), while Mana Regeneration is a refill rate (sustain). A build that scales damage off Maximum Mana wants the first mod; a build that just runs dry wants the second. The ring gives both, which is why it is attractive to casters.

Because the ring is a Sapphire Ring, its base implicit already contributes Cold Resistance, and the unique line stacks the same +(20-30)% range on top. So even ignoring the immunity and mana, it is a respectable cold-resistance jewellery slot - which is part of why it is so broadly useful and why its trade price stays high.
bullets: Chill and Freeze are removed; you are not locked by cold crowd control.
You are NOT immune to Cold damage, Brittle, or cold Exposure - only to the Chill and Freeze statuses.
Maximum Mana scales pool size (Archmage / mana-stacker damage); Mana Regeneration scales refill (sustain).
The +(20-30)% Cold Resistance comes from the Sapphire Ring base plus the unique line.

sections.title: Build usage
intro: Dream Fragments serves two different masters: a defensive one (skip chill/freeze) and a scaling one (Maximum Mana for Archmage and mana-stackers). The builds below lean into one or both.

builds.title: Spark Gemling Legionnaire
builds.description: A mana-stacking caster where Maximum Mana drives both Energy Shield (via Mind Over Matter / Eldritch Battery setups) and Archmage damage. The ring's mana roll is a core scaling piece, and freeze immunity keeps the caster mobile.

builds.title: Lightning Spear Amazon
builds.description: Mana-intensive and often in the thick of cold-heavy content; the ring's regen and chill/freeze immunity help sustain uptime without flask juggling.

builds.title: Mana-stacker / Archmage caster
builds.description: Any build scaling damage or defence off Maximum Mana wants the (10-15)% line. Prioritise the highest roll; combine with other mana sources for a bigger pool.

builds.title: Condition: you need attributes or life
builds.description: If your build is starved for attributes, life or resistances, a high-roll Rare Ring will usually outperform Dream Fragments. Use the ring only when freeze immunity or mana scaling is the actual bottleneck.

sections.title: Alternatives: Rare and other Unique rings
paragraphs: Dream Fragments is not automatically the best ring. A well-rolled Rare Sapphire Ring (or any Rare Ring) can deliver a larger Cold Resistance roll, plus attributes, life, energy shield and other resistances - the things a gear-starved build actually needs. If freeze immunity is not a live threat in your content, the Rare Ring's total package usually wins the slot.

Other Unique rings cover different jobs. Polcirkeln gives Cold damage and shatter synergy for cold builds; Levinstone offers mana and shock magnitude for lightning; Blackflame converts Ignite to chaos. None of these give Chill/Freeze immunity, so they are not direct defensive replacements - but they may beat Dream Fragments on raw damage if you do not need the immunity.

For mana scaling specifically, the ring's (10-15)% is one of several multipliers; jewels, the passive tree and a ring-bonus amplifier can all grow your pool. If you already have a large mana pool from those, the ring's marginal mana is less exciting and its price harder to justify versus a Rare Ring that fixes your resistances and attributes.
bullets: Rare Ring: better when you need attributes, life, energy shield or resistances more than immunity.
Polcirkeln / Levinstone / Blackflame: different unique roles; none grant Chill/Freeze immunity.
Mana scaling has other sources (jewels, tree, amplifiers) that may reduce the ring's marginal value.

sections.title: How to get Dream Fragments
intro: Dream Fragments is part of the general unique drop pool. There is no targeted farm, so you get it by drop luck, an Orb of Chance gamble, or trade.

routes.label: Random world drop
body: It can drop from level 12+ monsters anywhere, so in theory as early as Act 1. The base drop chance for a specific unique is low; Item Rarity and Atlas modifiers improve unique drops generally but not this item specifically.

routes.label: Orb of Chance
body: Using an Orb of Chance on a normal (white) Sapphire Ring can turn it into a Unique. Three uniques share the Sapphire Ring base (Dream Fragments, Whisper of the Brotherhood, Polcirkeln), so the chance of hitting Dream Fragments specifically is low.

routes.label: Trade with other players
body: This is the realistic way to get a well-rolled copy. Indicative Early Access trade prices for even a low roll have been reported around 90 Divine Orbs; verify the live price for your region and league on 2026-08-03 before buying.

marketNote: Dream Fragments is an Early Access-league luxury unique. Its price is driven by the Maximum Mana roll and the freeze immunity demand. Prices below are indicative snapshots, not live quotes; verify on the trade site for your region and league on 2026-08-03.

Scaling value depends entirely on whether your build uses Maximum Mana.

entries.question: Dream Fragments says I can't be Chilled or Frozen - does that mean I'm immune to ALL cold ailments?
summary: A player assumed the ring gave blanket Cold immunity, including Brittle and cold damage.
editorialAnalysis: The line removes only the Chill and Freeze statuses. You can still be made Brittle, still suffer cold Exposure, and still take Cold damage. The ring is ailment-status immunity, not damage or full ailment immunity.
officialAnswer: No. You are immune to Chill and Freeze only. Cold damage, Brittle and cold Exposure still apply, so keep your Cold Resistance up.

entries.question: Does a ring-bonus amplifier double the Maximum Mana and the chill/freeze immunity from Dream Fragments?
summary: A player wanted to know whether an amplifier unique multiplies the ring's bonuses.
editorialAnalysis: A ring-bonus amplifier doubles the magnitude of eligible ring modifiers, so the (10-15)% Maximum Mana and the +(20-30)% Cold Resistance are multiplied. The 'cannot be Chilled or Frozen' line is a boolean status grant, not a magnitude, so it is simply present - it is not 'doubled' but it is still active. The exact eligibility of each mod should be confirmed against the amplifier's current rules.
officialAnswer: The scaling mods (Maximum Mana, Cold Resistance) are amplified; the immunity line is just active and is not a number that doubles. Check the amplifier's current modifier-eligibility rules.

entries.question: I have an old Dream Fragments with 20% Maximum Mana. Can a Divine Orb update it to the current 10-15%?
summary: A player owned a pre-0.2 version (20% max mana) and asked whether a Divine upgrades it.
editorialAnalysis: Patch 0.2.0 changed the roll to 10% and 0.4.0 to 10-15%; the notes state existing items can be updated with a Divine Orb. A Divine re-rolls the numeric values to the current range. It does not add or remove modifiers, so the old 20% becomes a 10-15% roll - which is lower, not higher, than the legacy 20%.
officialAnswer: Yes, a Divine Orb re-rolls the values to the current 10-15% range, but it can only land within that range. A pre-0.2 '20%' item becomes 10-15% after a Divine, so divining an already-high legacy roll can reduce it.

entries.question: Is Dream Fragments worth a ring slot versus a high-attribute Rare Ring?
summary: A player compared the unique against a Rare Ring that fixes their missing attributes and life.
editorialAnalysis: If freeze immunity is not a live threat and your build does not scale with Maximum Mana, a Rare Ring with attributes, life and resistances is usually the better total package. The unique wins when freeze death is real or when Maximum Mana scaling matters.
officialAnswer: Use the ring when chill/freeze lockdown or mana scaling is the bottleneck; otherwise a Rare Ring is the better slot.

problems.symptom: I still got Brittle / took cold damage
directAnswer: Expected. The ring only removes Chill and Freeze. Brittle, cold Exposure and Cold damage still apply, so keep your Cold Resistance and respect exposure.
checks: Confirm the ring is equipped (not in a separate inventory).
Stack Cold Resistance and mitigate cold Exposure elsewhere.
Treat the ring as status immunity, not damage immunity.

problems.symptom: My Archmage damage did not change much
directAnswer: The (10-15)% Maximum Mana is one multiplier. If your base pool is small, the absolute gain is small. Grow the pool from the tree, jewels and other gear to make the roll matter.
checks: Check your Maximum Mana roll (10% vs 15% matters).
Add other mana sources before relying on this ring alone.

problems.symptom: Divine Orb lowered my old 20% max mana
directAnswer: Correct. A Divine re-rolls to the current 10-15% range; a legacy 20% becomes 10-15%, which can be lower. Only Divine if you want the current range.
checks: Decide whether the current range is worth the risk before using a Divine.
A pre-0.4 '10%' item can be divined up to 15%.

problems.symptom: Swapped in for a boss and now fail attribute requirements
directAnswer: The ring has no attribute mods, so swapping out an attribute-heavy Rare Ring can drop you below a threshold. Plan the swap and compensate elsewhere.
checks: Check skill and gear attribute requirements before swapping.
Use the swap only when freeze immunity is worth the attribute loss.

sections.title: Patch history and current vs legacy

changes: Dream Fragments drops with: +(20-30)% Cold Resistance, (10-15)% increased Maximum Mana, (30-50)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate, You cannot be Chilled or Frozen.
The Maximum Mana line is the 0.4+ range of 10-15%.
Pre-0.4 versions had a fixed 10% increased Maximum Mana; pre-0.2 versions had a fixed 20% increased Maximum Mana.
A Divine Orb re-rolls existing items to the current 10-15% range (per 0.4.0 and 0.2.0 notes). It cannot add or remove modifiers, so a legacy 20% becomes 10-15% after a Divine.

Trade identification: a 20% Maximum Mana roll is an un-Divined pre-0.2 item; the current maximum roll is 15%. Divine behaviour is automatic on use and affects only the rolled numbers, not which modifiers exist.
Dream Fragments now has '10-15% Increased Maximum Mana' (previously 10%). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Dream Fragments now provides 10% increased Maximum Mana (previously 20%). A Divine Orb can update existing versions.
